sources.title: PDF Embodied intelligence: Recent advances and future perspectives
sources.snippet: Embodied decision-making plays the "brain-like" role in the perception-decision-action loop. Given a perceptual state, often partial and uncertain, it selects goals and actions that maximize task success under real-world constraints such as safety, time, and energy, thereby augmenting robotic control with AI reasoning.
